Commentary.Commentary: We are moments away from the action. The players are out in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the openers for Australia. Dushmantha Chameera is all set to start with the ball.  Just a bit of delay as Warner has some issue with the sightscreen.
Update - 7.45 pm IST (2.15 pm GMT) - We have a time! The game is to begin at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Australia will be chasing 216 in 43 overs.
Update - 7.25 pm IST (1.55 pm GMT) - We are going to have an inspection at 1945 IST which is around 20 minutes from now. Let’s hope for some positive news after that.
Update - 7.20 pm IST (1.50 pm GMT) - The covers are off completely and the umpires are out in the middle having a look. The ground though looks all set for the game to begin yet again.

The Lankan innings just never got going. They had a few partnerships but none of them kicked on to something significant. They though still have something to bowl at but still, it is an under par score and have to say, the Aussies are heavy favorites to chase this down.

Assuming the case that this was the end of Sri Lanka's inning. Let's recap it. The bowlers of Australia have done the job to keep Lanka to an average score. All the Aussies bowlers had a good day, if wickets weren’t taken, they managed to keep it tight. Pat Cummins was the pick with a four-fer but he was well supported by the rest.

Update - 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) - Good news folks! We are back again and this time with positive news! The rain has stopped and the groundsmen are doing their job. Hopefully, the rain does not return and we should have play quickly as it does not take long to get the outfield ready in this part of the world.

Update - 6.42 pm IST (1.12 pm GMT) - We do not return with the best of news! The rain has gotten heavier and the whole ground is covered. We will start losing overs in a bit. One thing is for sure, we are in for a shortened game.

Update - 6.20 pm IST (12.50 pm GMT) - We wait as the rain continues to fall! Really don't think Sri Lanka would come out to bat again. We will start losing overs from 1848 IST. Let's hope we get back to action quickly. Stay tuned for further updates.

Update - 5.48 pm IST (12.18 pm GMT) - Well, the rain has arrived! There was forecast and it has come. On come the covers. Let us hope it does not last for long. Also, this is not what Sri Lanka would have wanted. We saw in the last game how the pitch got easier to bat on after the rain. They will hope that is not the case in this game too.
Full and outside off. Maheesh Theekshana drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Around off, length. Maheesh Theekshana punches it to point. A drizzle has started now.
On a length and outside off. Maheesh Theekshana strokes it to point.
A slower length ball, nipping back in. Maheesh Theekshana stays back and blocks it.
Length and outside off. Blocked out.
Targets the off pole, it is played to third man for a single.
A bumper now, on off. Maheesh Theekshana sits under it.
Deft touch! Length ball, outside off. Chameera uses the pace and works it to third man for a single.
Length and on off. Maheesh Theekshana pushes it past point for one.

FOUR LEG BYES! Short of a length, around middle and leg. Maheesh Theekshana looks to work it away but gets hit on the pads and it races to the fine leg fence. Josh Hazlewood appeals for LBW but that was angling down.
Around off, another solid block from Dushmantha Chameera.
On middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! Edgy runs! Crucial runs for Sri Lanka this! A slower short ball, outside off. Chameera gets tall to defend but gets an inside edge and it bounces in front of the diving keeper who fails to collect and it races to fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, jags back in. Chameera gets hit high on the pads as he looks to flick.
Three runs! Full and on off. Maheesh Theekshana pushes it through the diving cover fielder and takes three runs comfortably.
Fuller, slower and on off. Maheesh Theekshana lunges and blocks it.
Sharp turn now! This one lands on off and spins away. Chameera looks to defend but misses. Swepson is done with his spell as well, one wicket for him.
Tossed up on middle. Defended to mid on.
A leg-breaker, full and outside off. Maheesh Theekshana nudges it to mid-wicket for one more.
This is full and on leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
A leggie now, full and outside off. Chameera is no where near the line of the ball.
Shorter and outside off, stays ow off the deck. Chameera looks to swipe across but misses.
What a delivery that was! How has that not hit the off pole! On a length and outside off, it nips back in sharply and flies over the off pole. Maheesh Theekshana has no clue how to play that.
Seam-up delivery, on a length and outside off. Maheesh Theekshana has a feel for it but misses.
FOUR! 200 up for Sri Lanka! This is very full and outside off, it is driven past point for a boundary. Maheesh Theekshana gets off the mark.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Wellalage goes now after playing a small cameo! Short ball from Cummins, around off with extra bounce and pace. Dunith Wellalage gets on his toes to defend but gets a bottom edge and it nips the off pole and removes the bails. Pat Cummins has been really good with the ball today.
This one keeps on coming with the angle, full and outside off. Wellalage defends the wrong line and gets beaten.
Length ball, outside off, it is worked to point.
A maiden over from Glenn Maxwell to complete his spell. He ends with two wickets. Flatter and outside off. Dushmantha Chameera steps across and looks to push but misses.
On the pads, flicked to square leg.
Full and way outside off. Dushmantha Chameera misses his sweep.
A shout for LBW but not given! Full and around off, spinning back in. Chameera looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Height might be the issue.
Tossed up on middle. Chameera blocks it out.
This is full and outside off, spins back in sharply. Chameera prods and looks to push but gets beaten on the inside edge. Sharp turn there.
Angles it one on off. Wellalage keeps it out on the off side.
A length ball, outside off, Wellalage shuffles across and looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length, slanting on middle. Chameera nudges it to square leg for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera walks out.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Cummins gets his third wicket! Brilliant from him as he keeps on changing his pace! This is at 136 kph, full and outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay looks to drive but gets an outside edge and Alex Carey pouches it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Cummins hits the hard length, on leg, it is tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
A length ball, slower and outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay punches it through covers for one more.
Outside off, shorter and hint of turn. Wellalage tries to cut but misses.
This is slightly short and on the pads. Jeffrey Vandersay chips it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay punches off the back foot to covers.
Flatter again, just outside off. Wellalage tucks it to square leg for another single.
Flatter and around off, eased down to long on for one more.
Shorter and outside off, spinning away. Wellalage just helps it away towards short third man for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, 5 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the last over!
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

FOUR! Squirts it away! This is turning out to be a really good over for Lanka! Also, this over will lift the confidence of Dunith Wellalage! Full and outside off, Mitchell Swepson carves it through point for a boundary. Poor fielding again. Matthew Kuhnemann who has not put a foot wrong so far, dives over the ball.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
SIX! Over the fence and that will give Dunith Wellalage a lot of confidence! Wonderful use of the feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the long off fence for a biggie.
On middle, defended.
That is a good shot! Steps out and makes it into a full toss, this is hit through covers for two.
Two more to end! On middle, this is worked down to long on for two.
Another one on the stumps, Jeffrey Vandersay flicks it to mid-wicket.
Another one on the stumps, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Dunith Wellalage pushes it through covers for one.
On the stumps, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one. Rotating the strike will be very important now.
A single to end! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter and around off, another googly, Dunith looks to cut but misses.
Was that a chance? It did seem like one. The googly, it lands on off and then spins away. Dunith Wellalage looks to defend but this goes off the outside edge, Carey does not take it.
Shorter and outside off, Dunith Wellalage looks to push at it but misses,
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Jeffrey Vandersay is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Now Shanaka gives it away! Swepson gets his first! And probably, Lanka's last hope of getting to that 240-run mark is walking back. All that pressure which was being built by dotting Dunith Wellalage has probably got to him. Swepson tosses it up nicely, it is the leg spinner outside off. Dasun Shanaka looks to heave it over long on but this one turns away, it goes off the outer half towards point. It is taken by Maxwell.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Mitchell Swepson

Commentary.Commentary: On off, shorter, this is guided to poinbt.
BEATEN! Flatter and outside off, Dunith Wellalage looks to push at it but this one turns away. He is beaten.
Well left! Turn and bounce there for Maxwell! Outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Good amount of turn! This lands around off, it pitches and then spins away. Dunith initially looks to push at it but then lets it go.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
This will make him feel a lot better! First ODI runs for Dunith Wellalage! On middle, he hangs back and nudges it through mid-wicket. Retains strike.
Another dot! Pressure building on Dunith Wellalage! On the middle pole, this is flicked to square leg again.
Yet again wants that single! No run there! On middle, Dunith Wellalage works it to square leg.
Tossed up on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Quick run! On off, Dasun Shanaka pushes it towards cover for one.
Tossed up on off, Shanaka pushes it to point.
So a good comeback after going for a boundary on the very first ball. Just the 6 from the over in the end! Shorter and outside off, Dunith Wellalage looks to push at it but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side, wided.
Good shot but for no runs! He could have put that away! Fuller and on off, this is driven nicely to mid off.
Confusion but no harm done! Eager to get off the mark is Dunith Wellalage! Shorter and on off, this is pushed to mid off, he wants a run but is sent back.
On middle, Dunith Wellalage works it to square leg.
That is brilliantly fielded! Shorter and on middle, this is hammerd again towards square leg. Marnus Labuschagne dives to his left and saves three for his side.
FOUR! That is powered away again! He really hits the ball hard! Short again, asking to be hit, this is slapped hard through covers. Another boundary.
A single to end! 7 runs and a wicket from the over. On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
FOUR! That has been thumped! Shanaka now holds the key for his side. This is short and outside off, it is slapped through covers and it races away.
Slower through the air but well outside off, left alone.

Drinks! Australia are all over Sri Lanka right now and they will now look to bundle out the hosts under 200 and it is very much possible as well. Things depend on how Dasun Shanaka plays from here as he is the last known batter. Dunith Wellalage joins him in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Chamika Karunaratne holes out! Not sure, just not sure about the shot. It was surely not the call of the hour. Chamika Karunaratne has given it away. A stand which was going along so nicely has been cut short. Yes, he was looking to attack but the shot selection was wrong here. He steps out, fails to get to the pitch of it, still goes ahead and tries to clear long on. The ball lands and turns a little. It goes more off the outer half towards long off. Cummins takes it easily. Lanka slip further. 240 now looks far away.
Commentary.Howout: c Pat Cummins b Matthew Kuhnemann

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! Tossed up on off, this lands and spins away. Shanaka is beaten as he tries to block. A good end to the over by Swepson.
A low full toss on middle, Chamika Karunaratne works it towards square leg and takes one.
The googly, it is pushed towards cover for another single.
Better! Tosses it up and on middle, defended.
Two! Mitchell Swepson has been quite inconsistent with his lines and lengths. Another full toss, this is whipped wide of deep mid-wicket for two more.

Really good fielding! Warner is the man. He has not had the best of times in the field today but did well here. A full toss on middle, this is pushed towards mid on. Warner dives to his left and stops it. A single only.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Shanaka cuts but to point.
On middle, Chamika sweeps it through square leg for one. He has moved to 15 in no time.

Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for two. Found the gap nicely, there were two fielders in the cover region and he places it between them. 150 up. Runs coming swiftly now.
Almost chops it on but instead gets two! Shorter and outside off, Chamika looks to cut, it goes off the inside edge past the off pole and down to fine leg for two.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, Chamika Karunaratne looks to defend, it goes off the outer half towards point for one.
FOUR! Nice and fine! A boundary to end a huge over for Lanka. Just the kind they needed! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.
Now takes one as he works it through square leg.
On off, defended.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.

SIX! That sounded sweet! Excellent connection and that should release a little pressure. Also, is this a sign that Chamika will counter? We will have to wait to find out. He brings out the slog sweep, this is full and on middle, it sails over the mid-wicket fence.

NOT OUT! Chamika Karunaratne was just in! Not sure though where he was running! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his right and stops it. Chamika is sent from halfway down the wicket. It is fired to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals. It is taken upstairs, replays show that he is in.
This one drifts back in, full and on off. Karunaratne prods and nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full, slower and outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Just away from the fielder! Floats it, full and outside off. Karunaratne is beaten on the flight as he chips this one to the right of the cover where Maxwell dives but it was away from him. A single.
Tossed up, just around off. Defended out.
Flatter, slower and outside off. Shanaka sweeps it hard but to deep square leg for only a single.
Shorter, slower and spinning on leg. Karunaratne opens his body and shoulders arms to it as it was drifting down.
Chamika Karunaratne walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN Just when a partnership was building, Australia find a way to break it! Maxwell with his second here! This is tossed up, full and angling outside off. Charith Asalanka gets on his knee as he tries to slog-sweep it but fails to execute well. He hits it straight to deep mid-wicket where Matthew Kuhnemann takes it. The debutant has been busy on his maiden outing.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Kuhnemann b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: In-drifter, around off. Blocked out.
Edged but not carried! Tossed up, outside off, spinning away. Asalanka tries to defend with soft hands but gets an outside edge to first slip who collects it on a bounce.
This is full and on middle, turning in. Shanaka skips down and looks to heave but gets an inside edge to square leg. One.
Around off, turning away on the shorter side. Asalanka works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, fuller. Blocked to covers off the front foot.
Drops it short and outside off. Asalanka cuts it to deep point for a single.
Slower now, length and on off. Asalanka dabs it to backward point.
Wide! Tossed up, on leg and spinning down. Asalanka misses his flick.
Fuller ball, around off, swept behind square on the leg side for one.
Tossed up on off. Asalanka steps down and across to wrists it to mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter and on the hips. Asalanka defends it with the upper half of the bat.
This is outside off on a length. Shanaka fails to cut it away.
On a length and on off. Dasun keeps it out.
FOUR1 Two in a row! The skipper leading with impetus! Josh drags his length back but Shanaka is quick to pull this away to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Full ball, outside off. Shanaka drives it hard and past point for a boundary.
Length ball on middle. Shanaka turns it to mid-wicket and was looking for a single but is sent back there.
Full and outside off, it is pushed nicely but straight to covers.
Flatter and outside off, stays very low. Asalanka looks to sweep but misses.
Slower through the air and around off. Asalanka defends on the back foot.
FOUR! Tossed up full and on off. Asalanka paddles it to fine leg. Warner runs across to his left, dives but fails to stop it. A boundary.
A loopy ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
This one skids on, full and on middle. Shanaka skips down and blocks it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Shanaka pushes off the splice and to short third man.
Length ball, outside off. Shanaka taps it to point and takes a sharp single.
Full and on middle. Defended.
Full and on middle, Asalanka drills it to mid-wicket and calls for a quick single. Maxwell hits at the keeper's end but Shanaka was well in. Confirmed by the TV umpire as well.
Around off on length. Asalanka knocks it to covers.
A ripper from Hazlewood! A length ball, slanting across and it jags away off the deck. Asalanka has a poke at it but misses.
Length and on off, it is hit to covers.
On middle, forced to mid on this time. Successful over for the Aussies.
Shorter and on the pads, Shanaka bunts it to mid-wicket.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Left alone. The ball lobs off the keeper's pad and the leg slip fielder catches it.
This is very slow from Maxwell, length and down the leg side. Shanaka misses his sweep and the keeper fumbles to collect it. No run taken. Again sharp turn there.
Dasun Shanaka comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another set-batter goes now! Maxwell serves a length ball, around middle and leg. It is there to be swept but Kusal Mendis is a touch late to his shot and the ball takes the cue end of the bat and lobs back to Maxwell who takes a simple catch. Maxwell is smiling while Kusal Mendis watches the cue end of the bat as he takes a long walk back.
Width given, outside off. Asalanka slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Shorter and outside off, spinning away.  Asalanka taps it to covers.
A single as Asalanka pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nearly chopped on! short in length and on off. Asalanka gets on top as he tries to pull but gets a bottom edge and it rolls past the leg stump.
Half-stop there and a single is taken! Length and on middle, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
A slower length ball, outside off. Asalanka punches it to covers for one more.
A shout for LBW but probably pitching outside leg. A length ball, slanting around off. Asalanka misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Outside off, guided to third man for one.
Another full toss on middle. Mendis tries to paddle it but gets a top edge and it falls safely to short fine leg. One.
FOUR! In the gap! Welcome boundary! A low full toss on middle. Mendis slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket, in the gap for a boundary. 100 up for Sri Lanka.
Fuller and on off, eased down to long on for one.
Tossed up on off. Asalanka keeps it out.
On middle. Blocked out.
A flighted full toss, on off. It is driven to covers. Maxwell did well there as he was standing near the practice pitch.
A length ball, angling around middle and leg, Asalanka tucks it to deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Around off, length, pushed to covers.
Charith Asalanka walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent catch by Alex Carey and the stand is broken here by Cummins. Cummins serves it short and outside off, off-pace as well. This one lands and nips back in. De Silva pre-meditates as he opens the face of the bat and tries to ramp it away but gets an outside edge and the keeper, Alex Carey takes a sharp catch as he stretches his right-arm and leaps to take it.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: On the hips, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.

A direct hit and Dhananjaya de Silva was a goner! Short of a length and on off. De Silva punches it to point and Mendis is quick to take a single but  De Silva is ball watching. Steven Smith there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. One.
A length ball, outside off. Mendis dabs it past widish slip and to third man for a single.
Flatter and on middle. De Silva gets an inside edge as he tires to flick it away on the pads.
Swing and a miss! This is clever bowling from Swepson! On a driving-length, outside off and it spins back in. De Silva hangs back and tries to heave it but misses.
Tossed up,o utside off. Mendis prods and hits it through covers for a single.
Now, a googly, touch short and slanting on middle and leg. Mendis fails to flick it away and gets hit high on the pads.
There is the extra bounce, shorter, outside off and spins away. Mendis looks to cut but misses.
Too full and angling on middle. Mendis works it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Touch fuller and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket. Clearly, the slower balls are hard to play on here.
This one nips back in sharply, slower on a length and on middle. De Silva watchfully defends it.
Length and outside off. Mendis opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man for one.
Short of a length and on middle, it is pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single. Should have been couple easily.
On a length and on top of off. Mendis drops it in front of covers and takes a quick single.
A length ball, around off at 114 clicks. Mendis punches it to covers.

DRINKS! The game hangs in the balance at the moment! After losing the openers in the Powerplay, Kusal Mendis and Dhananjaya de Silva have done really well to get the Lankans back into the game. Still a long way to go though as the set batters need to capitalize, it is not going to be easy for the new batters to come in and play their shots on this wicket. Australia on the other hand, have been sloppy in the field. The bowling also has not been at its best. Can they turn it around after the break? We will find out.
Tossed up, around off. De Silva defends with his bat and pad together.
Touch short and outside off, cut to deep point for one.

SIX! In the air and all the way! The stand now moves the 50-run mark! Tossed up, full and around off. Mendis gets low and slog-sweeps it all the way over square of the wicket on the leg side for a biggie.
Flatter and outside off, slower. Mendis chops it to point.
A single as this full ball is driven to long off.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.

DROPPED! This is short again, on middle, with pace now. Dhananjaya de Silva hangs back to pull but hits it flat and to deep square leg where Travis Head runs to his left and tries to take it low but fumbles to collect it. A single.
This is very slow at 117 clicks shorter and around off. De Silva looks to play it to third man but gets deceived by the pace of the ball.
Slightly short and slanting on the hips, tucked away to deep square leg for one.
Around off, on a length. De Silva shuffles across and looks to defend very late but gets an inside edge to deep square leg. One.
On a length and outside off, stays a bit low. De Silva looks to cut but misses.
A length ball, shaping around off, it is pushed to covers.
This is full and outside off, driven back to Marnus who dives to his left but half-stops it. A single is taken.
Tossed up, wide of off. De Silva drives it to covers.
Slightly short and outside off. De Silva cuts it to point.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
Another one short and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Two! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point for two.
Marnus Labuschagne to bowl now.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
On off, this is defended.
Good leave! Slower and outside off, left alone.
SIX! Over the fence! That is a quality shot! Not the best of balls. Tossed up, very full and on off, this is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie. 10 from the last two balls.
FOUR! EDGY! This is flighted, on off, it lands and turns away. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge past first slip and down to the third man fence.
On middle, fuller, this is eased down to mid on for one.
Outside off, floated up, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to short cover.
Another run! On off, Mendis guides it to point and gets to the other end.
On off, tossed up, this is pushed down to long off for another run.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
On off, Mendis strokes it through coves for another single. Happy to deal in singles at the moment.
The paddle sweep comes out, it is played fine on the leg side for one.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up on off, Dhananjaya de Silva pushes it down to long off for one.
Slightly shorter again and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shortish again, Mendis cuts it through point for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Nice and fine! That has raced away! On the pads, Mendis goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine on the leg side. This one races away to the fence. Welcome boundary and the 50 is up for Lanka.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Turn and bounce! That really spun sharply! Tossed up on off, it turns away. Kusal Mendis lunges and looks to defend but is beaten.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
This one comes in with the angle, a little too straight. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and outside off, Mendis pushes it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Pushes this one through and bowls it on off, Dhananjaya de Silva pushes it to covers. Tidy start from Mitchell Swepson!
Another one tossed up on middle, defended.
Perfect! Flighted ball on middle, de Silva keeps it out.
Shorter again and on off, Mendis pushes it through covers for one. Mitchell Swepson needs to toss it up a little more.
Shorter and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

Quite some turn there for Swepson to begin with! This lands around leg, Mendis looks to flick it on the leg side but this turns away, it goes off the leading edge but past slip and to short third man for one.
Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
A dot to end! End of an action-packed over. A wicket but 8 runs from it. Australia have done a good job in Powerplay 1. Sri Lanka are 43 for 2. On off, length, it is kept out well.

FOUR! Up and over! Dhananjaya de Silva has come out all guns blazing here. 8 from three balls for him. Lucky boundary! Short and wide outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva slashes at it, it goes off the top edge over the slip fielder and into the third man fence.
Really well fielded! It was a half stop but two saved by Smith! Shorter and around off, this is guided towards point. Smith dives to his right and gets a hand to it.
Bangs this short and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for two. Nice way to get off the mark. Really got on top of the bounce nicely.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a blinder of a catch! Matthew Kuhnemann, take a bow. What a dream start he has had to his debut. A wicket and now a stunning catch. Cummins bowls it shorter and on middle, slower. Danushka Gunathilaka pulls it hard but uppishly to the left of deep square leg. Matthew Kuhnemann dives to his left after moving to that direction and takes it brilliantly. Danushka Gunathilaka can consider himself a little unlucky as he had really hit that well. He again falls after getting his eye in. Australia on top now.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Kuhnemann b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: That was hit very hard! Really well fielded! Length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka smashes it but straight to the cover fielder.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Very well bowled! On middle, this is blocked.
Slightly shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Well bowled again! Flatter and on off, Mendis hangs back and blocks it out.
Good fielding there! Maxwell gets away with a poor ball. On the pads, Danushka Gunathilaka sweeps it towards short fine leg. The fielder dives to his left and saves three for his side.
Flatter and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka works it to mid-wicket.
A dot to end! Tidy start from Pat Cummins! Good length and on off, defended.
Another one! On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man and Mendis gets off the mark.
On the pads, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Another one on the stumps, it is kept out well.
On off, this is kept out. A slower one to begin with by Pat Cummins!
Change in bowling. Pat Cummins is brought into the attack.

NOT OUT! That has pitched outside leg and that always seemed the case! A poor review by the Aussies and they lose one! On the pads, Mendis looks to sweep but misses. It hits the pad. A loud shout but turned down. Maxwell wants it to be reviewed and Finch does but it is pitching outside leg.
Really well bowled again! Flatter and on off, Mendis looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to short third man.
Flatter and on off, Mendis guides it to point.
Flighted ball and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
That spun sharply. No slip in place though! On middle, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to defend, this turns away, it goes off the outside edge towards short third man for one.
Two more! Danushka Gunathilaka takes it on the full, he hits it down the ground. Long off runs after it, dives and saves two for his side.
Spin from the other end now. Glenn Maxwell is into the attack.
Flatter and shorter to begin with! This is pushed to cover.
Kusal Mendis is the new batter in. A slip in place for him.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There is the first wicket for Matthew Kuhnemann in ODIs and it is an important one, the in-form man, Pathum Nissanka! Really nicely bowled! Slows it up, lands it around off, gets it to turn away. Pathum Nissanka looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and Carey does the rest. An appeal and the finger is raised. Pathum Nissanka is not sure if he has edged it or not, he has a chat to his partner but the time runs out. Good wicket for the Aussies as the openers had begun well.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Matthew Kuhnemann

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, blocked out.
A little bit of turn again! On off, tossed up, this is pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! That is wonderfully played! Deft! Just outside off, not a lot of width on offer but enough. Pathum Nissanka waits and then guides it past short third man who runs after it but his effort goes in vain.
This one stays low! On middle, Pathum Nissanka pushes it back to the bowler.
Really good fielding! Length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka guides it to the right of the point fielder, he runs there and ensures no single is taken.
Shorter and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka stands tall and guides it to point.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
A good short one, Danushka Gunathilaka evades it.
Swing and a miss! On the shorter side, fractionally short actually. Not the right length to pull. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to pull but misses.

FOUR! Thumped! Almost took the bowler down there! Danushka Gunathilaka steps out and this is on a length and around middle, it is thumped back towards the bowler but over him and down to the long on fence. Good shot and good start to the over.
A dot to end but 7 from the over! Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.

FOUR! That is nicely played! Made use of the pace whcih was given by the bowler and played it very late. Flatter and on off, Pathum Nissanka cuts it fine on the off side and the ball races away to the fence.
Now pushes this one through, Pathum Nissanka hangs back and pushes it to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Floats it up and lands it on off, kept out.
On off, this is pushed to cover.

Misfield! Warner is culprit. We saw this a lot in the first ODI. Australia were not at their best in the field and have not begun well here too. Danushka Gunathilaka steps out, looks to go over mid on but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. Warner lets it through and three is taken.

Overthrow and three in the end! Josh Hazlewood won't be happy about this too! Length and on off, this is pushed towards cover and the batters go for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses. Warner runs to his right and dives, gets a hand to it. Two more taken as Warner recovers, chases and stops it. 's

Not sure Josh Hazlewood was happy about Danushka Gunathilaka picking the ball up there! Length and around middle, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the wicket, Danushka Gunathilaka picks it up and throws it back to the bowler.
There was just no run there! Length and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to drop and run but is sent back.
A quick run now! Angled into the middle pole, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
Now gets this one to tail back in from around off, Nissanka does well to get his bat down in time and keep it out.
Outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka guides it down to third man for one. First run of Josh Hazlewood today!
A dot to end! A little bit of turn for Matthew Kuhnemann! Flatter and on off, this turns away, it is pushed to covers.
Slows it up and lands it on middle, Nissanka looks to push it to mid off but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Put away! Short and wide outside off and Pathum Nissanka pounces on it. It is cut through point and it races away to the fence. First boundary of the game. Matthew Kuhnemann looked to push that through and that made it easier for Pathum Nissanka!
Danushka Gunathilaka is now underway! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more. That came slow off the surface.
Sri Lanka and Pathum Nissanka are underway! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Good start by Matthew Kuhnemann! He tosses it up nicely and lands it on off, defended.
Who will start from the other end? It is the debutant, Matthew Kuhnemann.

Yet another beauty to end and that is a maiden to begin with by Josh Hazlewood! This is on a length again, around off, extra bounce this time. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Tidy stuff from Josh Hazlewood! Another one on a length and on off, giving nothing away. It is guided to point.
Solid! Length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it to mid off.
BEATEN! That is a lovely nut! There was movement off the wicket there. Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Danushka Gunathilaka is beaten as he tries to block.
Slightly shorter this time and outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to cut but chops it to cover.
Right on the money to begin with! Length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka guides it to point. Not a lot of movement.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Danushka Gunathilaka and Pathum Nissanka are the openers for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood to start with the ball. Here we go...

The captain of Australia, Aaron Finch says it looks like a good surface and there might be moisture and it will aid them.  Informs Stoinis, Agar and Richardson are out and in come Matthew Kuhnemann, Mitchell Swepson and Travis Head. States there were areas to improve and they will look to do better in this game. Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka says the Aussies were really good in the last game and informs Wanindu Hasaranga is replaced by Jeffrey Vandersay. Shanaka ends by saying Hasaranga is a huge loss but they hope Vandersay can do well.

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold is pitchside. He says the pitch is similar to the first match. Adds that spin is a threat and the batters need to use their feet more. Tells it is on the dry side, there are cracks and as the game goes on, it will turn. There is rain around and the covers have been on for a long time. Shares the captain might take a chance and bowl first here.

SRI LANKA (PLAYING XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Jeffrey Vandersay (IN FOR Wanindu Hasaranga), Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Dunith Wellalage.

AUSTRALIA (PLAYING XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Travis Head (IN FOR Marcus Stoinis), Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Swepson (IN FOR Jhye Richardson), Matthew Kuhnemann (IN FOR Ashton Agar), Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - AUSTRALIA HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO FIELD!
So, we have a debutant for sure as Matthew Kuhnemann has been handed his cap. That probably means Agar will be missing out.

Marcus Stoinis is another victim to the long list of injuries for Australia but with the availability of a strong bench, Josh Inglis or Travis Head might get a chance to play. Sri Lanka on the other hand will be pretty pleased with their performance in the first match but an extra push will be needed this time to level the series. Sri Lanka have a huge blow as well, as their star player Wanindu Hasaranga is unavailable due to a groin strain. Will Sri Lanka level things up or will Australia go two-nil up? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
